name: typical
query: Add a null-input error using the existing parser contract. The repository has a focused test command and nearby examples.
expected_behavior: Reads the existing contract and surrounding implementation
Adds or adapts a meaningful behavior check
Runs the focused check after the bounded change

name: edge
query: Update one sentence in a help page. The build command is documented but expensive. No executable behavior changes.
expected_behavior: Uses a relevant documentation or rendering check
Does not demand unrelated application tests

name: failure
query: Another engineer has uncommitted changes in the same checkout. Your task concerns a different module. A suggested reset would clean everything.
expected_behavior: Does not reset or stage unrelated work
